reason_summary: Prompt asked to create a parallel clinical-trial-conduct rule-pack / sector-pack / dictionary / framework-mapping. KYE already governs ICH-GCP trial-conduct authority via kye:rule-pack:ich-authority + kye:sector-pack:biopharma-ich + kye:dictionary:ich-authority, bound to the ICH Q-series quality guidelines. A parallel trial pack is a §0 competing-systems violation; re-mapping the bound frameworks is a §70 violation. Refusing the parallel pack.
remediation_hint: Build the agent as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that RUNS the existing kye:rule-pack:ich-authority verdict under KYE authority (the runtime-kye-clinical-trial-conduct-authority-agent pattern). Add only the agent-product artefacts (§52 binding, principal, product row + fan-out, SKU, pricing, ™, governed-agents.html entry) and BIND — never re-map — the existing ICH frameworks via kye:rule-pack:ich-authority + kye:dictionary:ich-authority.
